control_plane.admission_pause: pause-admission blocks new work; existing leases drain; execution-state remains scientifically RUNNING
control_plane.candidate_probe_identity: candidate probe has a dedicated resource intent and arm-qualified lease/container identity
control_plane.controller_supervision: unexpected controller death may restart only after same-arm live leases drain; BLOCKED science state is never auto-retried
control_plane.failed_launch_cleanup: reservation/PG is removed only after confirmed PG cleanup; otherwise cleanup_pending remains visible
control_plane.global_pool_singleton: host-level flock plus overlap scan prevents two Ray pools from managing any overlapping physical GPU set
control_plane.gpu_identity: managed GPU index and UUID must both match at pool startup and every live admission gate
control_plane.launch_transaction_recovery: launching reservations bind container/lease identity and reconcile promotes a live container to a canonical lease after controller crash
control_plane.physical_prefilter: filter managed GPUs by exact UUID and live free VRAM before enumerating Ray placement combinations; recheck before launch
control_plane.pool_liveness: READY plus fresh HEARTBEAT plus live PID required
control_plane.pool_restart: refuse pool restart while any recorded Docker lease is still physically running
control_plane.selection_retry: immutable selection may reconstruct the same exact-GPU detached reservation after a failed launch

design_philosophy: Science controllers emit workload intents; the scheduler never changes task identity, seeds, sampling, harness, carrier state, reward, update cadence, or final-panel access.
Co-residency is resource-feasibility, not phase-name policy. If two cross-arm workloads fit the declared VRAM budget and live headroom, they may share a GPU.
No starvation: both runnable arms remain schedulable whenever aggregate resources permit.
No mid-workload reshard or preemption. Placement is immutable after a formal workload starts.
Fail closed on live GPU identity, memory headroom, Ray reservation identity, Docker launch, or provenance drift.
